prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a parking lot collision. The patient had 10 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1178; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: The patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with a complaint of right knee pain and swelling. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported knee findings, and the presentation fits the force described. Over the course of ten visits, the patient received physical therapy, activity modification, and anti-inflammatory management. Treatment ran somewhat longer than is typical for this type of injury, largely due to a gradual rate of improvement in range of motion and strength. Examination revealed effusion and tenderness along the medial joint line, which support the reported injury, while ligament stability testing and neurovascular assessment were within normal limits. The patient mentioned a minor strain to the same knee area many years ago, which had resolved completely without lasting limitation. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no duplicate or repeated entries. Current status is improving, and the patient is expected to return to baseline function with continued home exercise.
